---
title: "Coerce data into a DuckDB-backed lazy table"
pagetitle: "Coerce data into a DuckDB-backed lazy table — make_db_tbl"
---

::: {.qrtdown-source .dont-index}
Source: [`R/utils-misc.R`](https://codeberg.org/usrbinr/ti/src/branch/main/R/utils-misc.R)
:::

<p>Ensures the input is a database-backed object. If a data.frame is provided,
it is registered into a temporary, in-memory DuckDB instance. If already
a <code>tbl_dbi</code>, it is returned unchanged.
</p>

## Usage

```r
make_db_tbl(x)
```

## Arguments

<dl class="qrtdown-arguments">
<dt id="arg-x"><code>x</code><a class="anchor" aria-label="anchor" href="#arg-x"></a></dt>
<dd><p>A tibble, data.frame, or tbl_dbi object.</p></dd>
</dl>

## Value

<p>A <code>tbl_dbi</code> object backed by DuckDB.
</p>

## Details

<p>When converting a data.frame, this function preserves existing <code>dplyr</code>
groups. It uses DuckDB's <code>duckdb_register</code>, which is a virtual registration
and does not perform a physical copy of the data, making it extremely fast.
</p>
